landmarks.name: Supratrochlear Notch
landmarks.clinicalNote: 1.7–2.2 cm from facial midline; exit of supratrochlear pedicle for paramedian forehead flap.

landmarks.name: Zygomatic Arch
landmarks.clinicalNote: Superficial temporal artery courses superficially over the posterior root of the zygoma.

landmarks.name: Mandibular Angle / Antegonial Notch
landmarks.clinicalNote: Facial artery crosses inferior border of mandible anterior to masseter insertion.

landmarks.name: Midpoint of Clavicle
landmarks.clinicalNote: Thoracoacromial trunk arises deep to pectoralis minor near the mid-clavicular line.

landmarks.name: Xiphoid Process
landmarks.clinicalNote: Inferior boundary of sternum; superior epigastric vessels pierce rectus sheath just inferolateral.

landmarks.name: Umbilicus
landmarks.clinicalNote: Periumbilical zone (within 3–4 cm lateral and inferior) harbors dominant DIEP perforators.

landmarks.name: ASIS (Anterior Superior Iliac Spine)
landmarks.clinicalNote: Key landmark for DIEP lateral taper, SIEA course, groin (SCIA) flap, and ALT reference line.

landmarks.name: Pubic Tubercle
landmarks.clinicalNote: Medial anchor of inguinal ligament; marks inferior incision limit for DIEP and gracilis reference.

name: Back & Posterior Trunk

landmarks.name: Inferior Angle of Scapula
landmarks.clinicalNote: Latissimus dorsi superior border crosses tip; TDAP perforators emerge ~8 cm below posterior axillary fold.

landmarks.name: PSIS (Posterior Superior Iliac Spine)
landmarks.clinicalNote: SGAP perforator reference: junction of upper and middle thirds of line from PSIS to greater trochanter.

angiosomeTerritory: Thoracodorsal, Circumflex Scapular & Superior Gluteal Angiosomes

landmarks.name: Radial Styloid
landmarks.clinicalNote: Distal pulse point of radial artery for RFFF design and preoperative Allen test.

landmarks.name: Lateral Epicondyle of Humerus
landmarks.clinicalNote: Posterior radial collateral artery courses in lateral intermuscular septum toward lateral epicondyle.

name: Hand & Wrist
angiosomeTerritory: Palmar Arch & First Dorsal Metacarpal Territories

name: Lower Limb (Anterior / Thigh)

landmarks.name: Superolateral Patella
landmarks.clinicalNote: Distal endpoint of ASIS–superolateral patella line; ALT perforator B clusters near the midpoint.

landmarks.name: Fibular Head
landmarks.clinicalNote: Common peroneal nerve wraps around fibular neck; leave 6–8 cm proximal fibula during harvest.

landmarks.name: Lateral Malleolus
landmarks.clinicalNote: Leave 6–8 cm distal fibula for ankle mortise stability; reverse sural pivot ~5 cm proximal.

angiosomeTerritory: Lateral Circumflex Femoral, Profunda & Peroneal Angiosomes

name: Lower Limb (Posterior)

landmarks.name: Inferior Gluteal Crease
landmarks.clinicalNote: PAP skin paddle designed 1–2 cm inferior to gluteal crease; perforators emerge 3–5 cm below crease.

landmarks.name: Popliteal Crease
landmarks.clinicalNote: MSAP perforators emerge ~8–12 cm distal to popliteal crease along medial gastrocnemius axis.

angiosomeTerritory: Profunda Femoris, Sural & Posterior Tibial Angiosomes

name: Ankle & Foot
angiosomeTerritory: Posterior Tibial, Medial Plantar & Dorsalis Pedis Angiosomes

name: Perineum & Groin
angiosomeTerritory: Internal Pudendal, Medial Circumflex & SCIA Angiosomes
